businesses.business: professional baseball and commercial real estate

offering_description.value: Operates a Major League Baseball team and sells game tickets, media rights, and sponsorships to fans, broadcasters, and advertisers. It stages home games at its ballpark and develops and leases nearby office, retail, dining, and entertainment space to businesses.

primary_products.value: team apparel and memorabilia; ballpark food and beverages

primary_services.value: live professional baseball games; sports media rights; sponsorship and advertising; commercial property leasing; private event hosting

customer_segment.value: B2C: baseball fans, game attendees, and merchandise buyers; B2B: broadcasters, sponsors, corporate hospitality buyers, and commercial tenants

end_markets.value: spectator sports; sports media; advertising and sponsorship; commercial real estate; private events

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: game admissions and parking; licensing or royalties: broadcast and streaming rights for baseball games; advertising: team and ballpark sponsorships, signage, and promotional placements; product sales: team merchandise and ballpark concessions; rental or leasing: office and storefront leases, ballpark suites, and event space
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; licensing or royalties; advertising; product sales; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: fields a baseball team and produces games for fans, broadcasters, and sponsors; asset operator: operates a leased ballpark for fans and develops commercial property for office and storefront tenants; retailer: sells sourced team merchandise to fans through ballpark shops

geography_served.value: US national: U.S. baseball audience concentrated in the Southeast, with ballpark and real estate operations in metropolitan Atlanta

specialization.value: diversified: Major League Baseball operations and mixed-use commercial real estate development and leasing

distribution_channels.value: online: official team and league ticketing websites and apps; own locations: ballpark box office, team shops, and concessions; partners / resellers: broadcast and streaming partners and authorized ticketing partners; direct sales: team sales staff for ticket plans, group outings, suites, and sponsorships; agents / brokers: commercial leasing brokers for office and storefront tenants
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; partners / resellers; direct sales; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: MLB operating rules and state and local requirements for venue safety, alcohol sales, and land use
